svg.title: Capability landscape for modern skill evaluation frameworks
svg.desc: An ordinal matrix comparing seventeen frameworks across skill identity, paired skill lift, stateful execution, trace evidence, executable checks, behavioral and semantic scoring, safety and static validation, and search or evolution. A green star means native support, a yellow document means documented but not native support, a blue hand means a manual adapter is required, and a red X means not supported or outside framework scope. The matrix does not rank overall product quality.
svg.text: Capability landscape: where each framework is strongest
Documented support as of 2026-08-30. This is a capability map, not a benchmark score.

svg.text: Read by column, not by row total: complete skill evolution requires execution, evidence, and promotion controls that often span multiple products.
